{{Quote|I will wager every credit I have|Armen Arandis|<ref name="The Queen of Air and Darkness">{{DoD|The Queen of Air and Darkness}}</ref>}}
'''Armen Arandis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] tactical officer stationed on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Assiduous]]''.

Arandis competed in the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], using the tournament as a cover-up to exchange funds in a clandestine deal with [[Darga Jiramma Mionne|Darga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. The which involved [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] was part of the [[Sarlacc Project]] the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] first attempt at creating a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype]]. His role in the tournament was being monitored by members of the [[Alderaanian Resistance]]. Lieutenant Arandis was [[Death/Legends|killed]] after the tournament, when fellow competitor [[Silas Draver]] attempted to steal the winnings at the event's conclusion.
